name: smokeproof
description: Real-browser pre-ship verification for AI coding agents and humans. Catch silent runtime errors, broken mobile layouts, dead buttons, and leaked secrets before shipping.

scripts.test: npm run build && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/unit.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/e2e.test.js
